positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what is the calibration status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph?
positions.why: Both expressions assert the same calibration state — Quill as a direct witness assertion that the spectrograph is calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates across the full observing band, and Xena as a declarative record of the same key decisions — cohering under the question of the instrument's calibration standing.
